outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY/CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION THURSDAY AND THURSDAY EVENING...AND EXTENDING INTO THE FLORIDA PANHANDLE BY FRIDAY MORNING. A FEW TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL ALL BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A POTENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE PERIOD AS IT MOVES FROM THE SRN PLAINS INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY AND CNTRL GULF COAST. STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL OVERSPREAD A LARGE AREA WITH RAPID COOLING ALOFT ATOP WARMING LOW-LEVELS RESULTING IN AN UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...ALONG WITH AMPLE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. LOW PRESSURE WILL DEVELOP OVER THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY BY LATE AFTERNOON...AND WILL MOVE NEWD ACROSS LA AND MS BY EVENING WITH COLD FRONT TRAILING SWD INTO THE GULF OF MEXICO. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S F DEWPOINTS WILL BE IN PLACE WHICH AT FIRST GLANCE MAY SEEM LOW...BUT SHOULD PROVE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS GIVEN COLD TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND STRONG COMPENSATING LIFT WITH THIS SYSTEM.

sections.title: FAR ERN TX...LA...CNTRL AND SRN MS...SWRN AL...FL PANHANDLE
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING EARLY ON THU FROM NERN TX INTO MS ALONG A WARM FRONT. SOME OF THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE HAIL. BY MIDDAY...STRONG FORCING NEAR THE SFC LOW AND COLD FRONT OVER ERN TX WILL LEAD TO SCATTERED STORMS...MOST LIKELY CELLULAR. HAIL APPEARS LIKELY WITH THESE CELLS...BUT VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT MAY ALSO RESULT IN A TORNADO THREAT WITH TIME AS THE STORMS BECOME MORE ESTABLISHED AND WIND PROFILES BECOME MORE FAVORABLE OVER TIME. MEANWHILE...WELL AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...MORE ISOLATED ACTIVITY ALSO IS LIKELY. CLUSTERS OF CELLS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ACROSS SRN LA BY AROUND 21Z...EVENTUALLY SPREADING INTO SWRN MS. THESE CELLS MAY PRODUCE TORNADOES...WITH THE GREATEST THREAT ACROSS THE ENHANCED AREA. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST OVERNIGHT AS THE COLD FRONT CONSOLIDATES A BROKEN LINE OF CELLS...AND THESE SHOULD AFFECT SERN LA...SRN MS...AL...AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. ..JEWELL/PICCA.. 01/21/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY/CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...AND EXTENDING INTO THE FLORIDA PANHANDLE BY FRIDAY MORNING. A FEW TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SFC LOW WILL DEEPEN AS IT MOVES ACROSS SERN TX INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY TODAY IN RESPONSE TO DEEP FORCING ATTENDING AN AMPLIFYING BUT PROGRESSIVE SRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH. BY NOON A COLD FRONT WILL EXTEND FROM THE SFC LOW OVER SERN TX SWD TO ALONG THE TX COAST WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EWD FROM THE LOW THROUGH CNTRL LA INTO SRN MS AND AL. THE LOW IS FORECAST TO MOVE THROUGH SCNTRL LA DURING THE COURSE OF THE AFTERNOON...REACHING WCNTRL AL TOWARD THE END OF THE PERIOD. DOWNSTREAM FROM THE LOW A WARM FRONT WILL MOVE SLOWLY NWD INTO CNTRL MS AND WCNTRL AL.

sections.title: SERN TX THROUGH LOWER MS VALLEY AND CNTRL GULF COAST REGIONS
sections.text: SFC OBSERVATIONS SHOW ONLY PARTIALLY MODIFIED AIR OVER THE WRN GULF WITH NEAR 60F DEWPOINTS NEAR THE COAST. THIS MOISTURE WILL ADVECT NWD TODAY AS THE WARM FRONT ADVANCES FARTHER INLAND IN RESPONSE TO THE STRENGTHENING LLJ EAST OF DEVELOPING CYCLONE. COLD AIR ALOFT WITH -18 TO -20C AT 500 MB ARE SUPPORTING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AS SAMPLED BY 12Z RAOB DATA...AND THIS WILL COMPENSATE SOMEWHAT FOR THE MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE RETURN. WIDESPREAD CLOUDS AND AREAS OF SHOWERS WILL LIKELY PERSIST IN THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR...BUT SOME BREAKS AND MODEST DIABATIC WARMING WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE AFTERNOON WITH 500-1500 J/KG MLCAPE EXPECTED. SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH ELEVATED STORMS DEVELOPING THIS MORNING. SFC-BASED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP TOWARD NOON ALONG THE COLD FRONT OVER SERN TX AS DEEPER FORCING BEGINS TO INTERACT WITH DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE ALSO LIKELY WITHIN ZONE OF EVOLVING PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE IN WARM SECTOR. THE LLJ STRENGTHENING TO 40+ KT WITHIN APPROACHING UPPER JET EXIT REGION WILL RESULT IN FAVORABLE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. INITIALLY DISCRETE CELLS SHOULD EVENTUALLY EVOLVE INTO A BROKEN LINE ALONG THE COL

sections.title: E TX TO THE LOWER MS VALLEY THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A SURFACE CYCLONE WILL MOVE EWD AND DEEPEN FROM E TX EARLY THIS AFTERNOON TO CENTRAL MS EARLY TONIGHT AND NW AL BY FRIDAY MORNING. THE CYCLOGENESIS WILL OCCUR IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH PROGRESSING EWD FROM CENTRAL TX TO THE LOWER MS VALLEY. STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL SLY FLOW IN RESPONSE TO THE CYCLOGENESIS WILL TRANSPORT A MODIFYING GULF AIR MASS NWD INTO SE TX AND THE LOWER MS VALLEY...S OF A WARM FRONT NEAR I-20. 12Z SOUNDINGS REVEALED RELATIVELY COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES /-15 TO -20 C AT 500 MB/ OVER THE DEVELOPING WARM SECTOR...WHICH WILL COMBINE WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW-MID 60S TO SUPPORT MLCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG ACROSS S CENTRAL LA THIS AFTERNOON WHERE CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW THE GREATEST SURFACE HEATING...AND LESSER BUOYANCY FARTHER N AND E THROUGH TONIGHT. ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN THE ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL WAA NEAR AND N OF I-20...WHILE NEAR-SURFACE-BASED CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN E TX AND WITHIN THE OPEN WARM SECTOR IN SE TX AND JUST OFF THE LA COAST. EXPECT THIS SCENARIO TO PERSIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS STORMS SLOWLY INCREASE IN BOTH COVERAGE AND INTENSITY...GIVEN LOW-LEVEL DESTABILIZATION AND LITTLE CONVECTIVE I

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY/CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...AND EXTENDING INTO THE FLORIDA PANHANDLE BY FRIDAY MORNING. A FEW TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE EXPECTED.

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: ASIDE FROM MINOR LINE TWEAKS TO ADJUST FOR CURRENT CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION/ADVANCE...NO CHANGES TO THE OUTLOOK APPEAR NECESSARY AS PRIOR FORECAST REASONING REMAINS VALID. STORMS NOW CROSSING THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY /INVOF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT/ WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS THE NWRN GULF AND SRN LA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...AND THEN EWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION THIS EVENING/OVERNIGHT. MEANWHILE...ISOLATED DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AHEAD OF THE FRONTAL CONVECTIVE BAND -- BOTH WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR AN IN PARTICULAR INVOF THE WARM FRONT EXTENDING ENEWD ACROSS CENTRAL LA/SRN MS. ..GOSS.. 01/21/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1006 AM CST THU JAN 21 2016/

sections.title: SERN LA...SRN MS/AL AND THE FL PANHANDLE
sections.text: A LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES TO RAPIDLY MOVE EWD ACROSS SRN MS INTO LA NEAR THE COLD FRONT WITH ISOLATED STORMS AHEAD OF THE FRONT AS WELL. OTHER CLUSTERS OF STORMS WERE LOCATED JUST OFFSHORE SRN LA WITH MORE RECENT DEVELOPMENT OFF THE FL PANHANDLE COAST. AS THE LOW CONTINUES TO DEEPEN OVERNIGHT...SHEAR PROFILES WILL BECOME EVEN MORE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE WEATHER INCLUDING A TORNADO RISK. THE LEADING EDGE OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION OFF THE GULF IS EXPECTED TO EVENTUALLY MOVE INLAND WITH PERHAPS A RENEWED SEVERE THREAT ACROSS SRN AL AND WRN FL PANHANDLE AFTER 06Z. FOR MORE INFORMATION...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 37. ..JEWELL.. 01/22/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS SE TX AND WRN TO CNTRL LA WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. TORNADOES...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION LATE THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1012 MB SFC LOW TO THE NORTH OF HOUSTON WITH A TRAILING COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM THE LOW. A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS EWD FROM THE LOW ACROSS CNTRL LA WITH THE WARM SECTOR LOCATED IN SE TX AND SCNTRL LA. SFC DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR RANGE FROM THE UPPER 50S F IN CNTRL LA TO THE MID 60S F NEAR THE LA COAST. SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE 60S F ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR HELPING TO INCREASE INSTABILITY. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED TO BE OVER 1000 J/KG ACROSS PARTS OF SW LA AND ACROSS MOST OF SE TX. THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE FRONT AND ALONG A CONFLUENCE ZONE AHEAD OF THE FRONT. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS THE SFC LOW DEEPENS AND THE EXIT REGION OF A MID-LEVEL JET OVERSPREADS THE REGION. THE MID-LEVEL JET IS CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WITH THE LAKE CHARLES WSR-88D VWP SHOWING 50 TO 55 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH 0-3 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITIES NEAR 250 M2/S2 SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR STORM ROTATION AND POSSIBLY TORNADOES. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 7.5 C/KM SHOULD ALSO BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. WIND DAMAGE MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH ROTATING STORMS OR SHORT-LINE SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL FROM AN ELEVATED SUPERCELL HAS DEVELOPED NW OF JACKSON. THIS THREAT MAY PERSIST WITHIN A RELATIVELY CONFINED AREA ALONG THE BIG BLACK RIVER DURING THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ELEVATED SUPERCELL DEVELOPED OVER WARREN COUNTY MS AND IS PROGRESSING ALONG THE BIG BLACK RIVER VALLEY. OBSERVATIONAL ANALYSIS PLACES THIS CELL AROUND 30 MILES N OF THE WARM FRONT EVIDENT ACROSS CLAIBORNE INTO SRN RANKIN COUNTIES AS OF 17Z. STRONG CLOUD-BEARING SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SAMPLED IN 12Z JAN/LCH RAOBS WILL SUPPORT A SEVERE HAIL RISK WITH THIS STORM. HOWEVER...THIS CELL WILL PROBABLY WANE IN INTENSITY IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO GIVEN A PREDOMINANT CLUSTER MODE AND WEAKER ELEVATED BUOYANCY TO THE N/E. A WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY FOR THIS THREAT...BUT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY LIKELY LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS GREATER SURFACE-BASED DESTABILIZATION OCCURS ALONG AND S OF THE I-20 CORRIDOR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL GRADUALLY SPREAD EWD ACROSS ERN LA AND INTO SCNTRL MS THIS AFTERNOON. TORNADOES...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE STORMS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST OF WW 5.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW A CLUSTER OF ROTATING THUNDERSTORMS ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONE IN WRN LA. STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE ALSO ONGOING ALONG A COLD FRONT IN FAR ERN TX. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED VERY NEAR TO A SFC LOW WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO DEEPEN AND TRACK EWD ACROSS LA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. SFC WINDS IN THE NERN QUADRANT OF THE SFC LOW ARE BACKED TO THE EAST AND SOUTHEAST WHICH IS ENHANCING LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. ALTHOUGH SFC WINDS ARE STARTING TO VEER TO THE SOUTH IN WRN LA...THE WSR-88D VWP AT POE WITHIN THE LAST HOUR HAS HAD 0-3 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITIES NEAR 300 M2/S2. THIS SHOULD BE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR FURTHER TO THE EAST NEAR THE MS RIVER WHERE INSTABILITY HAS MARKEDLY INCREASED OVER THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ROTATING STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE. AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST TORNADO RISK OVER THE NEXT 2 HOURS APPEARS TO BE FOCUSED FROM NEAR AND NORTH OF BATON ROUGE TO NEAR AND IMMEDIATELY SOUTHEAST OF JACKSON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES A TRIPLE POINT 1008MB LOW 30 MI NNW MCB WITH A STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE DRAPED NW TO SE AND AN EFFECTIVE/MARITIME FRONT EXTENDING FROM THE MOUTH OF THE MS RIVER NWWD INTO SERN LA AND NNEWD INTO S-CNTRL MS. A NARROW WEDGE OF RICHER AND PARTIALLY MODIFIED MOISTURE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 60S IS LOCATED WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR. VAD WIND TRENDS OVER THE PAST 2-4 HOURS AT KDGX SHOW SWLY WINDS INCREASING BY 10 KT IN THE 2-5KM LAYER--RESULTING IN A MODEST INCREASE IN HODOGRAPH SIZE /150-200 M2 PER S2 0-1 KM SRH/. AS STORMS CURRENTLY OVER SERN LA MATURE AND DEVELOP NEWD WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR AHEAD OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE...THE POTENTIAL FOR MESOCYCLONE DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION WILL PROBABLY INCREASE. A SUPERCELL TORNADO RISK WILL ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER STORMS AND A DMGG WIND THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST BOTH WITH THE SUPERCELLS AND WITH AREAS WHERE THE CONVECTIVE LINE SURGES/BOWS. ..SMITH.. 01/21/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED PRIOR TO 02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE OBSERVATIONS OVER SERN LA AND BUOYS E OF THE MOUTH OF THE MS RIVER INDICATE THE MARITIME FRONT IS ROUGHLY 50 MI S OF THE BARRIER ISLANDS OF MS AND AL. AS THE BOUNDARY ADVANCES NWD THIS EVENING COINCIDENT WITH THE APPROACH OF THE MID- TO UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH...A MORE FAVORABLE JUXTAPOSITION OF THE VEERING AND STRENGTHENING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT AND A MARGINALLY BUOYANT AIRMASS WILL SUPPORT 1) ISOLD STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS TO MOVE INTO THE REGION FROM THE W...AND 2) WARM SECTOR STORM DEVELOPMENT FROM THE CONTINENTAL SHELF VICINITY MOVING ASHORE AND POSING A SEVERE RISK. PRIOR TO THE CONVECTIVE LINE PASSAGE OVER THE MOBILE BAY AND WRN FL PANHANDLE VICINITY LATER TONIGHT...MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW 0-1 KM SRH INCREASING TO AOA 300 M2 PER S2---COMPARATIVELY HIGHER THAN VALUES OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. AS SUCH...A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED LATER THIS EVENING ONCE STORMS ENCROACH ON THE AREA FROM THE S AND W.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR TORNADOES AND A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT EAST ACROSS WW 7 THIS EVENING...WITH THE THREAT LIKELY MAXIMIZED ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH OVERNIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS THE MID/UPPER-LEVEL CYCLONE CONTINUES TO MATURE THIS EVENING NEAR THE SABINE VALLEY...THE LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE TO THE EAST FEATURES INCREASING SLY FLOW AND MODEST NWD TRANSPORT OF RICHER MOISTURE ONSHORE THE CNTRL GULF COAST. ADDITIONALLY...LOCAL VWP DATA SUGGEST THIS RESPONSE IS SUPPORTING 0-1 KM SRH UPWARDS OF 300 M2/S2. WHILE BUOYANCY DECREASES SOMEWHAT WITH EASTERN EXTENT /THUS REDUCING THE HAIL THREAT SOME THIS EVENING/...STRENGTHENING FLOW AND A MODEST INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO FAVOR UPDRAFT ROTATION IN CELLS MOVING ONSHORE...AS WELL AS WITHIN THE LINE APPROACHING FROM THE WEST. THE THREAT MAY BE PARTICULARLY MAXIMIZED OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS SRN AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE...WHERE STRONG 850-700 MB FLOW WILL OVERLAP A MAXIMUM IN LOW/MID-LEVEL BUOYANCY. ..PICCA.. 01/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLD WIND DAMAGE AND A WEAK TORNADO WILL CONTINUE FOR AREAS DOWNSTREAM OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE AND THE GREATEST RISK FOR SEVERE WILL LIKELY REMAIN WITHIN 50-70 MI OF THE COAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY OVER THE PAST HOUR HAS SHOWN COMPLEX CONVECTIVE/HYBRID STRUCTURES WITH EMBEDDED CIRCULATIONS CYCLING ACROSS BALDWIN COUNTY AL AND ESCAMBIA COUNTY FL. THE UPSCALE GROWTH OF THE CONVECTION INTO PRIMARILY A LINEAR SYSTEM IS OCCURRING LATE THIS EVENING AS STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT OVERSPREADS THE WEDGE-SHAPED MODIFYING WARM SECTOR OVER THE MCD AREA. EARLIER MODEL GUIDANCE DEPICTING ENLARGING HODOGRAPHS /300 M2 PER S2 0-1 KM SRH/ HAS BEEN OBSERVED IN THE KMOB VAD. DESPITE SURFACE DEWPOINTS ONLY RANGING FROM THE UPPER 50S TO NEAR 60 OVER S-CNTRL AL TO THE LOWER 60S NEAR THE FL PANHANDLE COASTLINE...THE STRONG LOW- TO MID-LEVEL WIND FIELDS WILL SUPPORT A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR DOWNDRAFTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE AND A WEAK TORNADO. ..SMITH.. 01/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/BRIEF TORNADO WILL CONTINUE OVERNIGHT ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE BUT POSSIBLY ALSO PARTS OF EXTREME SOUTHEAST AL/FAR SOUTHWEST GA. TORNADO WATCH 7 CONTINUES UNTIL 11Z/6AM EST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NNE/SSW-ORIENTED SQUALL LINE WITH MULTIPLE EMBEDDED BOW ECHOES/MESOVORTICES CONTINUES TO MAKE A STEADY EASTWARD PROGRESSION ACROSS THE WESTERN FL PANHANDLE AND SOUTHEAST AL AS OF 0730Z. MEASURED WIND GUSTS OVER THE PAST HOUR INCLUDE 50 KT AT WHITING FIELD NAS /KNSE/ AND 63 KT AT PENSACOLA NAS. RELATED TO THE AMPLIFYING UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY...FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE WHILE DEEP-LAYER WINDS ACROSS THE REGION STEADILY STRENGTHEN AND BACK /SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY/ IN THE MID-LEVELS PER WSR-88D VWP TRENDS. THIS SCENARIO WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR A HIGHLY ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE WITH EMBEDDED BOWS/MESOVORTICES. HOWEVER...THE SQUALL LINE WILL TEND TO OUTPACE THE MAIN LOW-LEVEL MOIST INFLUX...AND MOVE INTO AN INCREASINGLY STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER AWAY FROM THE COAST. IN OTHER WORDS...A MORE MARGINAL THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT ACROSS SOUTHEAST AL/SOUTHWEST GA SHOULD KEEP THE OVERALL DAMAGING WIND/BRIEF TORNADO POTENTIAL IN THESE AREAS VERY LOCALIZED/MARGINAL. IN FACT...SURFACE DEWPOINTS ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST AL/SOUTHWEST GA HAVE TENDED TO LOWER /LOWER 50S F/ OVER THE PAST 1-2 HOURS. THUS...THE RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS WILL BE ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE WITH THE SQUALL LINE AND RELATED BOWS/MESOVORTICES...AND ALSO WITH AN INLAND-DEVELOPING SUPERCELL OR TWO AHEAD OF THE LINE IN VICINITY OF A MARITIME WARM FRONT. ..GUYER.. 01/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 7 EXPIRES AT 11Z/6AM EST. AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/BRIEF TORNADO RISK MAY CONTINUE ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE BEYOND 11Z...BUT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN SQUALL LINE WITH EMBEDDED BOWS/MESOVORTICES CONTINUES PROGRESS EASTWARD ACROSS THE EASTERN FL PANHANDLE/SOUTHWEST GA AS OF 1030Z/530AM EST. CONSISTENT WITH LIGHTNING/INFRARED-SATELLITE INDICATED CLOUD-TOP TRENDS...THE STRONGEST STORMS SHOULD REMAIN FOCUSED ACROSS THE EASTERN FL PANHANDLE WITHIN 30-50 MILES OF THE COAST WHERE A SOMEWHAT WARMER/MORE MOIST LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT EXISTS. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/BRIEF TORNADO WILL REMAIN A POSSIBILITY WITHIN A HIGHLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT AS PER TALLAHASSEE WSR-88D VWP DATA. HOWEVER...AS THE STRONGER CONVECTION CONTINUES TO ENCOUNTER A PROGRESSIVELY MORE STABLE AIR MASS INLAND /50S F SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND DEWPOINTS/...THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY MARGINAL/LOCALIZED EARLY THIS MORNING.
